'''Toozler's Speeder Repair and Maintenance''' was a business in [[Ackbar City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]  [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] found the business long abandoned and repurposed it as a temporary headquarters during its investigation of Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. As part of its cover, the unit tentatively renamed the building "Bini's Speederium."<ref name="MK" />
